source.note: Generated from Genshin Optimizer sheets (master) + allStat_gen skillParam. Hit keys match GO target paths; multKey = <hitKey>_mult. Levels: Lv10, except constellation-boosted talents of 4-star characters at Lv13 (C6 assumed). Normal/charged/plunging default to physical unless the sheet overrides the element (infusions are NOT applied).

self_conditional_modifiers_json.description: C1 Flower of Eden: using Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma increases Albedo's own DEF by 50% for 20s. Matters because his Transient Blossoms and the Hexerei passive both scale off DEF.

Hexerei: Secret Rite (Witch's Eve Rite: Book of Blinding Light -- needs Witch's Homework and 2+ Hexerei characters in the party). After Albedo creates a Solar Isotoma, nearby party members' Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 4% for every 1,000 DEF Albedo has, up to +12% (so it caps from 3,000 DEF). Self scope, so this only applies when Albedo is the scored character: the rate is an eval-time conversion off his own post-buff DEF, which is what makes C1, Husk of Opulent Dreams and Cinnabar Spindle feed it per build instead of every entrant sharing one assumed DEF. A support Albedo uses the others-scope twin instead.

Hexerei: Secret Rite (Witch's Eve Rite: Book of Blinding Light). After Albedo generates a Silver Isotoma, nearby HEXEREI party members' Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 10% for every 1,000 DEF Albedo has, up to +30% (so it caps from 3,000 DEF). Stacks with the Solar Isotoma clause above; enable both only when the receiving character is itself Hexerei. Self scope, so this only applies when Albedo is the scored character: the rate is an eval-time conversion off his own post-buff DEF, which is what makes C1, Husk of Opulent Dreams and Cinnabar Spindle feed it per build instead of every entrant sharing one assumed DEF. A support Albedo uses the others-scope twin instead.
A1 Calcite Might: Transient Blossoms generated by Abiogenesis: Solar Isotoma deal 25% more DMG to opponents whose HP is below 50%. Scoped to the Transient Blossom hit (skill.blossom) only.

A1 Calcite Might (Hexerei: Secret Rite): while a Silver Isotoma created by Albedo is on the field, Transient Blossom DMG is additionally increased by 240% of Albedo's DEF. Needs Witch's Homework and 2+ Hexerei characters, like the other Hexerei clauses.

C2 Opening of Phanerozoic: Transient Blossoms grant Fatal Reckoning stacks (max 4). Unleashing Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide consumes them all, and each stack consumed increases the DMG dealt by Fatal Blossoms AND the burst's own DMG by 30% of Albedo's DEF. Pick the number of stacks consumed.

C6 Dust of Purification (Hexerei: Secret Rite): using Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide destroys all Silver Isotomas on the field, and each one destroyed this way increases Fatal Blossom DMG by 250% of Albedo's DEF for 20s. Scoped to the Fatal Blossom hit (burst.blossom) only.

team_conditional_modifiers_json.description: A4 Homuncular Nature: using Elemental Burst Rite of Progeniture: Tectonic Tide increases nearby party members' Elemental Mastery by 125 for 10s.
C4 Descent of Divinity: active party members within the Solar Isotoma field have their Plunging Attack DMG increased by 30%.
C6 Dust of Purification: active party members within the Solar Isotoma field who are protected by a Crystallize shield, or while Moondrifts are present in the field, have their DMG increased by 17%.

others_conditional_modifiers_json.description: Hexerei: Secret Rite (Witch's Eve Rite: Book of Blinding Light -- needs Witch's Homework and 2+ Hexerei characters in the party). After Albedo creates a Solar Isotoma, nearby party members' Normal/Charged/Plunging Attack, Elemental Skill and Elemental Burst DMG are increased by 4% for every 1,000 DEF Albedo has, up to +12% (so it caps from 3,000 DEF). Others scope, so this only applies when Albedo is a teammate: his DEF is not on the scored build, so the admin types it and the per-point rate is multiplied by it. The authored states stay as coarse presets for anyone who would rather pick one.
